name: Millwright
tagline: Bolt it in, run it hot, or stash it for a better roll.
core_loop: Roll the pressure die, take one card from the shared yard (or use your stockroom), then fit it as an ascending upgrade, run it for grade x mechanism level, or reserve it face down.
win_condition: Highest score after the closing round, including 4 bonus points per mechanism fitted to level 4.
